rule: A rank period is two game weeks. It starts on a Monday 02:00 UTC — the same boundary reset_week_start returns — but only every other one, counted from the epoch below. rank_period_start(ts) returns the most recent period start at or before ts (boundary inclusive).
why_this_epoch: A fortnightly grid has two possible phases and both are real Monday 02:00 UTC boundaries. The first anchor was 2026-07-27, taken from arena's own reported week_start; arena weeks start on Monday too, so 2026-08-03 is the same kind of boundary one week over. The alliance chose this phase, so periods run 08-03 to 08-17 and every other Monday from there. That is a change of PHASE, not of rule — but it moves every boundary, so these vectors and both implementations moved together (0071).
whose_fortnight: The game has no two-week anything. Daily rankings and daily arena reset every day; the donation and duel boards reset weekly. The fortnight is OUR aggregation unit, chosen because ranks are reviewed that often — which is why its phase is a free choice rather than something the protocol dictates.

measurement_points.contribution_and_duel: 01:59:00Z on the last day of each of the two weeks — one minute before the game wipes the WEEKLY boards. Two captures per period, summed.
measurement_points.power: the period's own two boundaries, 02:00Z at the start and 02:00Z at the end. Power does not reset, so the boundary itself is a fine place to read it.
measurement_points.not_the_daily_boards: Daily rankings and daily arena must NOT be summed across a period. One reading of a board that resets every day is one day's figure, and adding two of them over a fortnight would understate everybody by whatever was not captured. If a daily figure is ever wanted per period it needs a reading per day, which nothing collects yet.

absent_is_not_zero: A period with no captures in it must not produce figures of zero and a tier of 'score'. Before 0071 it did: 93 members were graded R3 over a fortnight that predated the collector, and offline_hours came back at -225 because presence was read from outside the period. donation_total and duel_total are null when neither week was read, activity_score is null when every input is absent, a member with no activity_score gets no tier, and presence is bounded by the period's end.
not_a_consumer: services/collector — nothing there needs a period yet, and an implementation with no caller is one that drifts unnoticed. Add it there when something asks.

vectors.name: the epoch is its own period start
one second before the epoch falls in the previous period
the odd week in between belongs to the period that started before it
and so does the last moment of it
two weeks on is the next period
midweek lands on the period it is inside
the previous anchor is now mid-period, which is what the phase change means
well before the epoch still resolves, on the same fortnightly grid
a year on stays on the grid
